annotation.interpretation_a: The implementation is permitted to stop delivering stream data as soon as it receives the RESET_STREAM, even if some data hasn't been processed yet.
annotation.interpretation_b: The implementation is permitted to *continue* delivering stream data until all buffered data is consumed, and *then* interrupt delivery upon receiving the RESET_STREAM.
annotation.justification: The use of 'MAY' grants discretion, but the lack of further constraints on *when* the interruption can happen creates two reasonable interpretations. One interpretation allows immediate interruption, while the other allows delivery to complete before interruption.
annotation.missing_information: The clause does not specify *when* the interruption of delivery must occur relative to the receipt of the RESET_STREAM and consumption of buffered data. This creates ambiguity about the timing of the interruption.
